svg.title: Five solutions for asymmetric routing with principle, fit and cost, plus a selection table that starts from the constraint
svg.desc: Five rows. One, converge on a single stateful device: both ISPs terminate on the same firewall HA cluster where BGP and NAT live, fitting medium to large sites with public services, at the cost of that device becoming the capacity and failure focus so high availability is mandatory. Two, active-standby: one exit is preferred for all directions and the other only backs it up, fitting small to medium sites, with an idle standby and sessions breaking on switchover. Three, policy-based routing to force symmetry by pinning outbound to the same exit as the return path, fitting clear traffic classification but operationally complex and hard to troubleshoot. Four, eBGP multihop with NAT on the edge router, so BGP and NAT live at the edge and the firewall only inspects internal to DMZ, fitting the case where exit must be decoupled from inspection but leaving the firewall blind to outbound traffic. Five, accept asymmetry and remove state dependencies by disabling strict reverse path forwarding, using stateless ACLs and moving NAT to the host, losing stateful inspection. A selection table maps constraints to recommendations.
svg.text: Five ways to live with asymmetry, ranked by what they cost you
Nobody removes asymmetry by adding a routing command. You either remove the state, duplicate the state, or force one path.
解法
原理
适用
代价
收敛到单一状态设备
两条 ISP 接同一对防火墙（HA 集群），BGP 与 NAT 都在这里
中大型、有对外服务
该设备成为容量与故障焦点（必须 HA）
主动-备用
一个出口为“所有方向”的优选，另一个只备份
中小规模
备用闲置；切换有会话断
PBR 强制对称
按源/目的把去程钉在与回程相同的出口
有明确流量分类
运维复杂、易与路由策略冲突、难排障
eBGP 多跳 + 边缘做 NAT
BGP 与 NAT 都在边缘，防火墙只检测内网—DMZ
出口与检测要解耦
防火墙看不到出向流量（安全盲区）
接受不对称，去掉状态依赖
关严格 uRPF、用无状态 ACL、NAT 放主机侧或不做
纯转发出口等特定场景
失去状态检测，安全等级下降
SELECTION: START FROM THE CONSTRAINT, NOT FROM THE TECHNOLOGY
有对外服务 + 要求无感切换
解法 1（HA 集群 + 状态同步）
预算有限、可接受分钟级中断
解法 2（主动-备用 + 明确 SLA）
链路质量差异极大（如 MPLS + 宽带）
解法 3（按业务 PBR）或解法 2
检测能力已在上游/云上
解法 4（边缘做 NAT，本地只做粗 ACL）
纯转发出口，无合规要求
解法 5
Every solution trades state for either money, symmetry or inspection. Write down which one you are giving up - the incident will ask.
